what: The record disc keeps spinning one turn per 1.8s (33⅓rpm). Dragging with the mouse spins it around the disc center by the cursor angle, like scratching by hand, and on release it recovers its own speed at a rate of 3 per second. Switching sides (fx:flip) flips the disc on the Y axis in .72s expo.inOut, and fx:pause slowly brings it to a stop
ease: Spin none · recovery exponent follow-up · flip expo.inOut

options.turn: Length of one full rotation (sec), default 1.8 — 45rpm is 1.333
options.catch: Rate at which it regains its own speed after release (/sec), default 3
options.paused: If 1, starts paused — played with fx:play
options.touch: If 1, touch scratches too (only when the slab does not cover the whole screen)

use: · Flip: el.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('fx:flip', { detail: 'B' }))
note: Touch devices do not accept drag by default (the page must scroll) — touch: 1 only when the plate is small
